hook: Your walk in Meghalaya crosses a bridge that is alive.
title: Your Bridge in Meghalaya Is a Living Tree
description:
In Meghalaya, villagers grow bridges from the roots of rubber fig trees. They guide the roots across rivers over decades, and some of these bridges are centuries old. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Meghalaya #LivingRootBridge
comment_prompt: Would you walk across it? Yes or no
